name: Imouto Spiral
source:
Seiji is a normal male student without a girlfriend, except that he has strange dreams almost every day. One day, he was going to be reunited with his younger sister whom he haven't seen since they were small. However, not one, but five younger sisters were waiting for him! It happened that some incident caused the protagonists from different parallel worlds to disappear and their younger sisters went searching for them. All of them ended up coming to Seiji since he was the same as their brothers. At the same time, strange dimensional distortions started appearing around him, threatening the balance of all the worlds. How will he and his younger sisters confront this crisis?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
诚司是一个没有女朋友的普通男学生，但他几乎每天都会做奇怪的梦。一天，他即将与从小分离的妹妹重逢。然而，等他的不是一个，而是五个妹妹！原来，某个事件导致不同平行世界的主人公们消失了，他们的妹妹们便开始寻找他们。由于诚司和她们的哥哥长得一模一样，所有人都来到了诚司身边。与此同时，奇怪的空间扭曲开始在他周围出现，威胁着所有世界的平衡。他和他的妹妹们将如何面对这场危机？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
